{{Quote|Come on, let's dance. I'll make it last.|Jake upon revealing his double-bladed boots|<ref name="SotME" />}}
'''Double-bladed boots''' were weapons that looked like ordinary work [[Boot/Legends|boots]], but when the boot was given a kick twin blades emerged from the toe. A [[miner]] named [[Jake (miner)|Jake]] attacked [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] with double-bladed boots and [[double-bladed stiletto]]s on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]].
